name: mb
description: Karpathy's LLM-Wiki pattern as a Claude Code plugin. Build and maintain a persistent, AI-tended research wiki from sources, capture daily thoughts, query what you know, lint for orphans and contradictions. Operations: /mb:init, /mb:contribute, /mb:build, /mb:ask, /mb:lint, /mb:status, /mb:research, /mb:daily-brief, /mb:migrate.
